title: Local operator API has no caller authentication: assess cross-origin and local-process exposure of mutating routes
outcome:
A written assessment, with tests where behaviour is asserted, of who can call TermAl's mutating local routes, such as POST /api/federation/settings, /api/settings, /api/telegram/config and the new peer recover route.
- It confirms the listener binds loopback only.
- It confirms what the CORS policy allows: whether a web page in Greg's browser could trigger a state-changing request, including simple-request and no-preflight cases.
- It confirms that remote federation peers cannot reach operator routes through the pair router.
- If a real exposure exists, it proposes a minimal hardening, for example an Origin check, a per-install token for the UI, or preflight-forcing content types, as a decision for Greg.
acceptance: Local operator API has no caller authentication: assess cross-origin and local-process exposure of mutating routes is done
